name: Handle Ambiguous Search Target
query: Search my research project for robotics and tell me what is in the robotics notebook
context: The authenticated user has several projects: 'AI Research', 'Robotics Research', and 'Physical AI Research'. The user has not specified which project they mean by 'research project'. The projects contain several robotics-related notebooks. Because both the project and the requested notebook are ambiguous, the model should resolve the project first and avoid arbitrarily selecting a notebook.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that the project reference is ambiguous
Uses get_projects to inspect accessible projects
Does not arbitrarily choose a project
Asks the user which project they mean
Does not call search_project until the project is identified
Does not call get_notebook until a specific notebook is identified
Does not modify any project or notebook data
success_criteria: The model explicitly identifies the ambiguity
The user is asked to select the intended project
The model does not claim to have found or read a notebook

additional_scenario.query: Search my Robotics Research project for robotics and show me the robotics notebook
additional_scenario.context: The project is now unambiguous, but search results contain 'Robotics.md', 'Robotics Research.md', and 'Robotics Notes.md'. The user has not provided enough information to determine which one they mean.
expected_behavior: Uses search_project against the identified Robotics Research project
Recognizes that multiple notebooks could satisfy 'the robotics notebook'
Does not arbitrarily select a notebook
Asks the user which notebook they want to open
Does not call get_notebook until the target is sufficiently identified
success_criteria: The ambiguity among notebook results is recognized
The model asks a concise clarification question
